name: Ungratefulness
overview: Scripture reveals that ungratefulness is a failure to acknowledge God's goodness and provision, as seen when Israel lusted for flesh despite His care (Numbers 11:4) and when people suppressed thankfulness after knowing God (Romans 1:21). Yet, God's kindness extends even to the unthankful, calling believers to love and do good without expecting anything in return (Luke 6:35). Contentment and trust in God's faithful presence (Hebrews 13:5) stand in contrast to the heart that is darkened by ingratitude, reminding us that true life and salvation come through faith in Christ's sacrificial love (John 3:16).
